exposure: Maturity onset diabetes of the young (MODY)
outcome: Percentage change in preprandial and basal insulin dosage
cohort: 121 pregnant women with hyperglycemia requiring insulin therapy were enrolled in the study.
finding: Insulin requirements were highest for women with T1DM and MODY, and pregnant women with GDM experienced a gradual increase in insulin requirement and percentage of preprandial insulin from early to mid- and late pregnancy.
